name: The Buccaneers
description: A group of fun-loving American girls burst onto the scene in tightly corseted 1870s London, kicking off an Anglo-American culture clash. Sent to secure husbands and status, the buccaneers' hearts are set on much more than that.

videos.title: American Poison
videos.overview: A group of young American heiresses are changed forever when they're whisked across the Atlantic to London.

videos.title: Women or Wives
videos.overview: Conchita hosts a raucous country house party. Jinny and Lizzy go head-to-head for the same man. Nan reveals a secret.

videos.title: The Perfect Duchess
videos.overview: At the exclusive Tintagel ball, Nan considers the prospect of becoming a duchess. Conchita struggles with her mother-in-law's approval.

videos.title: Homecoming
videos.overview: The girls return to New York for a grand celebration. Nan seeks answers from her family. James begins to manipulate Jinny.

videos.title: Failed Betrayal
videos.overview: Things unravel during a weekend at Guy's family home, as Nan finds herself feeling torn. Mabel and Honoria get closer.

videos.title: It's Christmas
videos.overview: The gang head to Scotland for a Christmas getaway. Lizzy makes a confession. James' behavior escalates. Nan faces a hard choice.

videos.title: First Footing
videos.overview: The Brightlingseas host a New Year's Eve party where the bombshell news is the hot topic. Tensions flare as Theo and Guy's rivalry explodes.

videos.title: Wedding of the Season
videos.overview: Nan must figure out her path forward. Jinny feels trapped. Mrs. St. George reckons with the state of her family.

videos.title: The Duchess of Tintagel
videos.overview: Nan's wedding day is in full swing, but a surprise appearance by someone from her past threatens to derail the festivities.

videos.title: Holy Grail
videos.overview: Amid the Tintagel spring gala, Lizzy grapples with whether to share crucial information with Nan.

videos.title: Get Her Out
videos.overview: A betrayal, a reunion, and an unexpected spark—Lizzy's enchanted birthday party will be one to remember.

videos.title: Ice Cream
videos.overview: From sun-drenched Italy to a champagne-soaked English garden party, emotions run high and chances are taken.

videos.title: A Whole Love
videos.overview: The buccaneers prepare for Lizzy's wedding day. Nan returns to face the music as things get more complicated.

videos.title: Every Single Piece of My Heart
videos.overview: Tensions are set aside—for now—to help Jinny fight for her freedom.

videos.title: All Rise
videos.overview: In New York, the scandalous St. George divorce trial is underway. Nan copes with further revelations about her birth mother.

videos.title: She Knows
videos.overview: The end-of-season Tintagel Ball sets off an explosive chain of revelations and betrayals—and Nan's life will never be the same.
